summary: Season 0: Tingen. Minecraft 1.21.1 with NeoForge and the Beyonder mod.

editions.name: Standard
editions.description: Beyonder Shaders (soft shadows, red moonlight, flickering gaslight, coal-smoke fog, lamp glow) plus Distant Horizons, sound physics and ambient sounds, Ambient Environment, Particular particles and Interactive Foliage. Needs a dedicated graphics card.

editions.name: Lite
editions.description: The core game with the performance mods (Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, Dynamic FPS) and voice chat; no shaders or extra visual and sound mods. The Tingen color grade, fog and Spirit Vision still apply. Runs on most computers.
